description: Per-dimension grading contract for the M2 dig-path scenario (chunked terrain + 8-material launch set proof). Validates that the player can distinguish dirt-fast / concrete-slow / metal_nohook-refused / anchor-refused via captures + events. M2.5 owns mission/reactor; this scenario is sandbox-only.

dimensions.criterion: Different terrain materials (air, dirt, concrete, metal_nohook, hazard, loose_fill, repair_fill, anchor) are visually distinguishable in the captures.
evidence_required: captures/summary_grid.png — frames where the player's dig hits each material in turn

dimensions.criterion: terrain_carved + tool_refused HUD labels visible in the captures; refusal_reason should be inferable from the HUD state.
Dig actions produce terrain_carved or tool_refused within 1-2 ticks of the cfctl command.

Soft materials (dirt) carve fast; medium materials (concrete) carve slow; refused materials (metal_nohook, anchor) emit refusal events without carving. Check with: per-dig hardness budget consumed appropriately + dirty_chunk_count grows for soft, refusal_count grows for refused.
evidence_required: events.jsonl terrain.terrain_carved + terrain.tool_refused tick patterns + observe.once terrain.{carve_count,refusal_count}

dimensions.criterion: M2 systems exercised: ChunkedTerrain.try_carve (soft + medium hits), try_carve refused (metal/anchor), AABB-overlap-solid for projectile collision (if exercised), per-material affordances visible in observe.once.

Bundle contains summary_grid.png + capture_manifest.json + events.jsonl + summary.json + run_manifest.json. M2 cfctl scripts may not produce a run_manifest.json (no --write-run-bundle in self_play_sweep) — note that as PARTIAL.
